{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column: is it truly text with commas?
print("First few values of revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].head(10))

# Check for commas in revenue
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nRows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check if all non-null revenue values have commas
all_comma = sales['revenue'].dropna().str.contains(',', na=False).all()
print(f"All non-null revenue values have commas? {all_comma}")

# Check for invalid revenue values (e.g., 999999.99) — the QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")"}
